Hi, I'm Rohit — a Master's student in Data Science at the University of British Columbia, building toward a career as a Data Scientist / ML Engineer. Before this, I spent time as a Data Engineer at Commonwealth Bank of Australia, working on financial crime data pipelines. I'm drawn to problems where data and machine learning can create real, tangible impact.
